As one of the leading healthcare improvement companies in the U.S., Premier’s mission is to improve community health by enabling better, smarter, and faster healthcare for providers. Serving two out of every three U.S. Databricks SQL serves governed analytics, dashboards, and ad hoc queries for business users and operational teams. Databricks Assistant helps practitioners accelerate code, query, and troubleshooting work inside the Databricks workspace. Databricks Genie lets business users ask natural-language questions over curated data. Power BI presents dashboards and reports to business users and planners.
